about: Known dependency advisories that cannot be fixed yet. `npm run audit:check` fails on any critical or high advisory in production dependencies that is not listed here, and on a listed one whose reviewBy date has passed. Add an entry only with a reason; remove it when a fix ships.

exceptions.reachedThrough: kokoro-js -> @huggingface/transformers -> sharp (also a direct dependency, used by src/library/visual-review-contrast.ts)
exceptions.reason: sharp decodes images with libvips and libheif. Reel Studio uses it in one place, src/library/visual-review-contrast.ts, on the PNG frames its own renderer captured from Chrome, never on an uploaded or downloaded file; @huggingface/transformers uses it for image pre-processing, which the text-to-speech voice never reaches. The advisories need a malformed image to be decoded, which this app does not do. No fixed version of the chain exists yet. sharp is declared as a direct dependency (0.35.5, pinned like the other dependencies; the version the lock file already resolved at the top level), so it no longer depends on the voice chain to be installed.
